recommendation.rationale: Conservative maximin screen: NLD + ESP has the highest minimum annual increment across the client-defined low/base/high/stress cases among alternatives within EUR450,000 capex and seven FTE. Low EUR43,994.29, base EUR166,931.42, high EUR289,868.56, stress EUR107,630.13; minimum EUR43,994.29. This is an explicit downside preference, not a probability forecast or causal estimate.

ranking_basis: Recommend the feasible alternative with the highest minimum annual incremental contribution across the client-defined low/base/high/stress cases; use base-case contribution to identify and compare the strongest different alternative. No scenario probabilities or board preference weights were supplied.

quality.source_status: Client transaction and option files are synthetic. World Bank and ECB files are official public snapshots collected into the frozen source room; archive vintage is 2026-09-27 and may include subsequent historical revisions.

handling.orders: Deduplicate identical full rows, choose highest numeric revision per order_id across both extracts and correction file; corrections replace the whole row. Include shipped, non-test 2025 shipment dates only. Keep zero-price shipments; exclude January 2026 orders.
handling.returns: Deduplicate identical full rows, choose highest numeric revision per return_id. Include received_at through 2026-01-31 inclusive only when linked to an eligible selected order. Quarantine orphan/ineligible returns; add distinct valid return IDs. COGS recovery follows restocked_quantity only.
handling.fx: Use original sale month ECB mean local-currency-units-per-EUR quote for gross sales and aggregate refunds; EUR=1. No inversion.
handling.missing: Do not impute source missingness; list missing FX/unit-cost orders and retain World Bank nulls. No missing values were detected in required calculation fields.

quality.accounting: Per selected eligible order: gross local price net of discount and refund credit summed in original sale currency, each translated at original sale-month ECB mean local units per EUR, rounded half-up to EUR cents. EUR quote=1. Net COGS = rounded gross unit cost less rounded recovered restocked unit cost. Fulfillment is nonrefundable. Contribution = net sales - net COGS - fulfillment. Returned units count received physical quantity.

source_files.units: local currency units per EUR; full ECB table
source_files.period: daily ECB reference rates; includes 2025; lossless extraction of ecb-history.zip

source_files.units: GDP per capita: current US dollars
